title: Intuition Adventures
description: A magic and exploration mod featuring custom abilities, a new dimension, and organic gameplay.
body:
Intuition Adventures is a magic and exploration mod for Minecraft Forge (1.16.5 & 1.20.1). It shifts the focus away from traditional tech and machines, offering a suite of custom spell-like abilities, a deep philosophical narrative, and a world where your very existence is under siege by the "consensus reality."

The Awakening & The True Self
The consensus reality is broken. As you step into this world, you will eventually face a profound realization: you are not just a character surviving in a sandbox, but a multidimensional being currently living a temporary player experience.

You are not alone in this. Throughout the world, Piglins are "awakening," breaking free from their standard AI loops and expanding their consciousness to see the truth of the Rift. However, this awakening brings terrible betrayal. They are actively hunted by the Karmic Hunters, a rigid society acting as the old reality's immune system. They brand expanded consciousness as a "mental illness" and seek to violently suppress any entity—including you—that attempts to break the rules.

The 100th Day: The 3 Days of Darkness
The cycle is finite. When you reach the 100th day of your journey, the sun refuses to rise. The 3 Days of Darkness have fallen.

As the light fades, the Leviathan emerges from the abyssal ocean depths to reclaim the fractured reality. This is not just a boss fight; it is a cataclysm. While the Leviathan is active, the very air you breathe is toxic to your spirit.

The Life-Force Drain: If you dare to use your Rift Flight during this event, the Leviathan will actively drain your life force, forcing you to fight a grueling war of attrition.

The Unstoppable Force: With a regeneration rate of 180 HP every 5 seconds, the Leviathan will not go down easily. You must master your abilities to overcome its nearly infinite vitality.

Core Mechanics & Abilities
You don't need to craft complex machines; instead, you utilize your true multidimensional energy via custom keybinds:

Thought Forms (T): A psychic toolset allowing you to break and reshape blocks using your mind instead of standard tools.

Shape-Shifting (V): Target a living entity and press 'V' to morph into it. (Press 'R' to reset).

Ascension Healing (H): Instantly heal your character and wipe away negative status effects on command.

Rift Flight (L): Tap into the Rift's energy to toggle creative-style flight in survival mode. (Warning: Dangerous during the 3 Days of Darkness).

Kingdom Builder (K): Magically generate lush, African-inspired environments in the world around you.

Super Poison (Soul Rot): Unleash a devastating, hyper-lethal toxic affliction upon your enemies. It bypasses standard protections to rapidly drain vitality—but use it wisely, as some entities are masters of regeneration.

The reality you see is a cage. Intuition Adventures is the key. Will you survive the 100th day?

Pro-tip for your project: When you upload this, add the "3 Days of Darkness" / "Leviathan" encounter as the primary screenshot on your mod page. It is your strongest visual asset and it will stop the scroll for anyone looking for a mod that changes the way Minecraft is played!
